## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 22 user-facing changes.
### Improved
- Changes from your other devices arrive through iCloud Sync without pausing Crest's windows. - The command palette now opens out of the address field and closes back into it. - The Space selector's outline and its selection now share the same corners. - Editing tabs does less work in large sessions. - Navigating in a Space with many tabs or a long history does less work. - Next and previous tab, and ⌘1–⌘9, now follow the order you see in the sidebar. - Dragging in the sidebar now says why a spot won't take what you're holding, a whole split can join the tabs on show or drop into a collapsed folder, and selections stay selectable in long lists. - When the sidebar can't take a drop, it tells you in the window's notice instead of an alert you have to dismiss.
### Fixed
- A folder you delete just before choosing this device's copy over iCloud's stays deleted on your other devices. - A Quick Window page you keep as a tab keeps the page's title instead of its site's name. - Tabs moved together in the sidebar can be dragged again right away. - Fix the Chromium build crashing on launch when built for release
---

## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 95 user-facing changes.
### New
- Chromium feature flags open inside Crest Settings.
### Improved
- In the desktop browser, camera, microphone, location and notification requests use Crest's own prompt, are remembered per Space, and can be reviewed and revoked in Site Controls and Privacy. - Tab icons in the desktop browser take on a site's theme colour, and refreshing a site's icon works there too. - Split cards and Peek in the desktop browser zoom pages with a fixed minimum width to fit, as they do on WebKit. - An extension side panel requested from a Quick Window now explains that side panels open in the main window. - Crest's link and Space actions appear first in native page menus while browser and extension actions stay available. - Page dialogs and website sign-in prompts work across both desktop browser engines. - Playing Chromium videos can enter Picture in Picture when switching tabs, with a window that settles into a screen corner.
### Fixed
- Clear Site Data and Reload works in the desktop browser. - Extensions that open their side panel themselves, such as ChatGPT, now open it on the first click in the desktop browser. - Extensions that work with a companion app, such as ChatGPT, 1Password and Claude, now connect to it in the desktop browser even when the app was only set up for Chrome. - Keep unfinished page loads from changing saved tabs or history while preserving completed page titles and icons.
